evidence_boundaries: The exact certificate covers rational intervals and an entire deformation-parameter strip, not sampled points.
The many-digit critical and resonance parameters are non-certified diagnostics and are not used by the proof.
The fixed-operator cutoff is sharp only for coefficient exp(-n); optimization over coefficients is open here.
A unique nondegenerate global span maximum does not establish strict span unimodality.
No claim that the resonance parameter is algebraic or reduces to a named constant.
Novelty is relative to inspected sources, not an exhaustive literature or repository-wide priority claim.
